annotations.title: Who controls this contract, and what is pending

description: Who controls a covered contract right now: who holds each role and what that holder is (a single key, a Safe and its threshold, a DAO, a known contract); what each role can change and how much notice (timelock) each change gives; and the changes queued in the contracts it reads, when each can take effect and who can revoke it. A notice that is not known (notice_s null) does not mean there is none. For a Morpho vault, before a deposit or while holding: the owner, curator, guardian or sentinels, and allocators. For a Compound v3 market: its governance and the Timelock every change waits in, what is queued or under vote and who can cancel it, and who can pause the market. For a stablecoin: who can mint, burn, pause, freeze, upgrade the contract or appoint those roles. For a Safe: its signers' threshold, modules and guards, and the vault roles it holds (holds_roles_on); a Safe changes in one transaction, so nothing in it is pending. Deterministic facts from the chain at a stated block; a title search, not a rating, so it returns no safety score. An address that is not covered returns covered: false.

address.description: The contract's address on Ethereum mainnet (0x and 40 hex digits), e.g. a Morpho vault's, a Compound v3 market's, a Safe's or a stablecoin's. Not a name: use search_covered_contracts to find an address.
